title: Build your own state store
description: Ashgrove Press takes orders on a little order screen Sefton wrote, and it keeps its state in a dozen places, so the basket count in the header disagrees with the basket and a change in one corner never reaches another. You write the shop a small store of its own in plain JavaScript: one place for the state, listeners told after every change, parts read on their own, changes with names, including one that waits, and last a hook that joins it to the React order screen. By the end you know what the store you use every day does each time you read or change it.
